mapper.sql: from product as a left join discount b on b.dc_id = a.discount_dc_id where 1=1
mapper.select:
select aa.* from ( select a.pd_id, a.name, a.local, a.local_detail, a.brand, a.type, a.capacity, a.liquor, a.fixed_price, a.discountNY, a.product_number, a.discount_dc_id, b.dc_id, b.discount_name, b.discount_rate, b.discount_dateS, b.discount_dateF
ORDER BY a.pd_id desc )aa limit #{startRnumForMysql}, #{rowNumToShow}

select a.pd_id, a.name, a.local, a.local_detail, a.brand, a.type, a.capacity, a.liquor, a.fixed_price, a.discountNY, a.product_number, a.discount_dc_id, b.dc_id, b.discount_name, b.discount_rate, b.discount_dateS, b.discount_dateF from product as a left join discount b on b.dc_id = a.discount_dc_id where 1=1 and pd_id = #{pd_id} ORDER BY a.pd_id desc
select a.dc_id, a.discount_name from discount as a where 1=1 ORDER BY a.dc_id desc
mapper.insert:
insert into product( pd_id, name, local, local_detail, brand, type, capacity, liquor, fixed_price, discountNY, product_number, discount_dc_id ) values( #{pd_id}, #{name}, #{local}, #{local_detail}, #{brand}, #{type}, #{capacity}, #{liquor}, #{fixed_price}, #{discountNY}, #{product_number}, NULL #{discount_dc_id} )
Select last_insert_id()
mapper.update: update product set name = #{name}, local = #{local}, local_detail = #{local_detail}, brand = #{brand}, type = #{type}, capacity = #{capacity}, liquor = #{liquor}, fixed_price = #{fixed_price}, discountNY = #{discountNY}, product_number = #{product_number}, discount_dc_id = 1 #{discount_dc_id} WHERE 1=1 and pd_id = #{pd_id}
